privateSnapshot.sha256ReproducibleContentHash: captured raw data SHA and record hashes are inside gzip

previousCapture.role: Previously reported complete capture before the literal DOM projection refinement; original gzip file was not found in the private audit directory when this receipt was finalized.

legacyReconstructionAttempt.disposition: Do not treat as the original capture. The replay was from current captured inputs with the prior literal detector; it does not reproduce the previously pinned bytes.

capture.ownerUniverse: rules, spells, equipment, classes, matrices, and progressionExplainer; non-routed source-card objects excluded
renderedTextSurfaces: source control text and data attributes
capture.searchSurface: The app-built closure-local FirstEditionSearch index text, exact public title/subtitle/type, plus 1,000 title probes executed by the real renderCommands function.

codeAndInstrumentation.instrumentationScope: Adds one window hook after successful initialize() calls. It reads the closure-local app-built index and invokes the app renderCommands(query) for each owner title. It does not alter data, renderer functions, search scoring, routes, CSS, or production files.
codeAndInstrumentation.crawl: One local SPA on an ephemeral loopback static server; each of the 1,000 collection-qualified routes was set with replaceState and sent through the app hashchange listener; no source-viewer control was clicked. Priority handoff captured classes/rules/matrices/progression first.

fieldProjection.method: Exact raw value substring for multiword strings of at least 10 characters first; normalized whole-token sequence fallback. Checks captured app-visible detail innerText, exact detail textContent including closed details, actual search text, and captured source-control attributes independently. Literal detector only, not semantic proof.

revision.recomputedFrom: captured exact sourceRecord, detail innerText/textContent, actual search document, and source-control attributes; no browser route recrawl

fieldProjection.interpretation: Literal occurrence candidates only. This is not a semantic defect list, source verification, or completeness metric; some fields are provenance/status, some are transformed by the renderer, and punctuation/format changes can affect matching.

knownNegativeCandidates.disposition: Unresolved projection candidate for source owner review. The field may overlap authored notes; no UI change or source interpretation is approved.

classPendingMechanics.interpretation: Stored candidate text is present in detail DOM and actual index; most entries are in collapsed details. DOM presence is not visible-on-load and is not promoted to extracted mechanics.

limitations: The browser did not open source viewers; controls are captured as controls, not reviewed source imagery.
Field-value literal matches are heuristic and do not determine whether content is intentionally metadata, duplicated, transformed, or user-facing.
No production changes, content changes, citation mapping, or source approvals were made.

failureCalibration.evidenceKind: Captured terminal stderr/output from the first all-owner run; original pre-fix source file/hash was not separately preserved, so this is not a replay.
